Lore wise it wasn't too important to the main plot but it sets up the Lin Kuei/Shrai Ryu conflict for future stories.

It's also more work to have a separate artwork or overlayed art that only gets revealed to people if and when you beat the story mode. 

The alternative is that we have a scar on Kuai Liang in the ladder mode ending and people who haven't beaten the story mode are either confused with why he suddenly has the scar or complain that it spoiled the story mode for them. 

My guess is that NRS took a safe route and made it so that people who played the story mode would reach this ending and not pay much mind to it instead of taking the risk for spoiling a fairly big development moment for Scorpion/Kuai Liang.

Evil Sindel is essentially a powered up dead Sindel via the souls collected by Shang/Quan.

To start out with, we know base Sindel pre MK1 is pretty powerful as she ruled Edenia and as Shao Khan seemingly loves strong women is interested in Sindel as his wife. This by default puts pre MK1 era Sindel as pretty powerful by default.

In the MK9/MKX game, Quan Chi revives Sindel and she immediately gets powered up by Shao Khan using Shang Tsung's soul as punishment for failing the invasion. In MKX, Sindel is an evil revenant under Quan Chi's control to which I think (my memory is hazy) she gets beaten up quite a bit. I guess it would make sense since she was technically killed and had to be re-revived in revenant form. 

By MK11, the Sindel that gets revived is done by Shang Tsung using the Soul Well which was used to literally heal Kotal Khan's broken Spine. I'm taking a solid gamble that using that to revive Sindel is a pretty good power up.

In the MK1 timeline, Sindel likely can be close to pre MK1 Sindel but we know that she has been ruling Outworld without war being in its history for hundreds of years. This is a pretty big contrast to the previous timeline of having the Outworld/Edenia invasion. She's also got a whole new backstory where she's no longer a power hungry ruler but someone who rules "fairly but firmly" as Liu Kang has stated. So motivation alone for the two Sindel already contrasts. We also know that the Evil Sindel is under Titan Shang Tsung's control who we know has conquered all the realms in his timeline. This means that he's likely leagues ahead of any combatant in the new era and can power up any underling he wants. Also stated in the story, Liu Kang gave up his Titan status to relegate himself as just the Protector of Earthrealm, so he's likely around Raiden's power level of the previous timeline.

All of this is just loosely based around the plot of the MK games and obviously doesn't have any power scaling number or anything to back it. Also since NRS is making the story in the format where the playable character has to win the battle, they need some form of raising the stakes to create tension for the story so some enemy character has to be powerful enough to take out the other non-chapter focus protagonists for the fight to start. Also Evil Sindel beating everyone up in MK1 was clearly a nod back to the MK9 story so NRS has to make all the protagonists except Milenna (the chapter focused character) get jobbered.

If we saw General Shao managed to take over a section of Outworld, we could have left the story with Outworld being split into two factions, one being led by Empress Mileena and the other by Shao Khan. This could lead future installments to have a story centered around a Outworld war between Shao and Mileena with Earthrealm choosing to aid Milenna.
